description_en: Invokes GetLiveRoomStatistics to query the statistics information of a specified live room. This operation is planned to be replaced by a new solution and is not recommended
description_zh: 调用GetLiveRoomStatistics查询与指定直播相关的数据统计信息。后续计划迁入新方案，不推荐使用
name: GetLiveRoomStatistics

parameters.help_en: The application ID. This ID is generated when you create an application in the console. It consists of 6 lowercase letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the live room resource
parameters.name: live_id

Result.description_en: The result returned for the live room statistics query
Result.description_zh: 查询直播统计数据返回的结果

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the live room, in milliseconds. This value is generated after the live room ends
EndTime.description_zh: 直播结束时间，单位：毫秒。直播结束后生成
EndTime.title_en: 直播结束时间，单位：毫秒。
EndTime.title_zh: 直播结束时间，单位：毫秒。

LiveId.description_en: The unique ID of the live room resource

Pv.description_en: The number of page views. Multiple visits by the same visitor to the live room are accumulated in the PV count
Pv.description_zh: 访问用户人次，访客对同一直播间的多次访问，PV累加

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the live room, in milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 直播开始时间，单位：毫秒
StartTime.title_en: 直播开始时间，单位：毫秒。
StartTime.title_zh: 直播开始时间，单位：毫秒。

Status.description_en:
The status of the live room. Valid values:
0: Created but not started.
1: Streaming.
2: Ended
Status.description_zh:
直播状态。取值：
0：已创建，未开始直播。
1：直播中。
2：直播结束
Status.title_en: 直播状态，0-已创建 1-直播中 2-已关闭。
Status.title_zh: 直播状态，0-已创建 1-直播中 2-已关闭。

Uv.description_en: The number of unique visitors. Multiple visits by the same visitor to the live room are counted as one UV
Uv.description_zh: 访问用户数，同个访客多次访问直播间仅计算一个UV

WatchLiveTime.description_en: The total watch duration of all users, in milliseconds. This value can be retrieved during the live stream with a data delay of a few minutes. For live rooms created before June 24, 2022 00:00:00, this value is generated only after the live room ends
WatchLiveTime.description_zh: 所有用户总观看时长，单位：毫秒。在直播中可获取该信息，数据延迟时间为几分钟；在2022.6.24 00:00:00之前创建的直播，需要在直播结束后生成

Result.title_en: 创建场景化直播返回的结果。
Result.title_zh: 创建场景化直播返回的结果。
